rationalization.consequence: The zone's dissolved oxygen fell below the declared tier — the permit-relevant direction
rationalization.required_action: Restore the zone's air supply or reduce the oxygen load the zone is carrying

rationalization.consequence: The zone's dissolved oxygen rose past the declared tier — air is being wasted or the measurement has drifted
rationalization.required_action: Check the zone's DO probe and reduce the air the zone is delivering

rationalization.consequence: The zone's delivered airflow fell below the declared mixing floor
rationalization.required_action: Restore the zone's air supply or raise the declared floor for a genuinely lower design load

rationalization.consequence: The zone's DO probe spread exceeds the declared tolerance
rationalization.required_action: Check or replace the disagreeing DO probe

rationalization.consequence: The zone's declared DO-loss response is engaged
rationalization.required_action: Restore the zone's DO measurement or accept the declared safe airflow

rationalization.consequence: The zone's air demand is under operator takeover
rationalization.required_action: Return the zone to automatic control or confirm the manual rate is intended

rationalization.required_action: Attend the machine before restarting it on the header

rationalization.consequence: Discharge-header pressure sits outside the declared bounds
rationalization.required_action: Restore the blowers to the header or reduce the zone demand the header is carrying

rationalization.consequence: The coordinator has no headroom left to optimize
rationalization.required_action: Reduce the zone air demand or open the header's declared bounds

rationalization.consequence: A grid's mixing pulse is refused by the declared simultaneous-pulse cap
rationalization.required_action: Reduce the number of grids pulsing at once or raise the declared cap

rationalization.consequence: A blower stage change is waiting for the operator's release
rationalization.required_action: Release or refuse the pending stage change on the blower group

rationalization.consequence: No blower is available to the header
rationalization.required_action: Restore availability on a machine or start the train on the machines that remain

rationalization.consequence: Every blower reads faulted
rationalization.required_action: Attend the reported machine faults before restarting the header
